Oneliner

First satellite in Taihang constellation. Dual-use (military and civilian) commercial intelligent satellites.
Description

As the first satellite in the Taihang constellation, composed of over a hundred satellites, independently developed by North University of China, North University of China Satellite-1 will be launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on the 10th of this month. This will be a pioneering achievement for universities worldwide in developing dual-use (military and civilian) commercial intelligent satellites.
Notes

Reported to be a CubeSat but details and size are unknown.
